notes.title: Release soon
notes.notes:
Dear friends!
The game is about to be released. Its quality is completely worthy. But I would like to immediately warn that there is not much content. Of the available 4 types of weapons, 2 cards. Buildings are currently not available, but I promise not to delay and will release in the coming months. I hope you like it, I like it at least)
